references.text: Moses recounts the event where the Israelites defied the Lord's command and went up to the mountain in their presumption.
Parallel account in Deuteronomy where the people confessed their sin and attempted to go up to the mountain.
The immediate context where the people decided to go up to the mountain despite Moses' warning that the Lord was not with them.
The ark of the covenant went ahead of the people when they broke camp, but here the ark remained in the camp because the Lord was not with them.
The Lord warned that he would not go with the people among them on account of their stubbornness.
A similar case where Israel could not stand against their enemies because the Lord was not with them due to sin.
The Israelites brought the ark of the covenant into the camp, but God's presence did not guarantee victory because they lacked obedience.
